name: ui/safe-area-frame
title: SafeAreaFrame
summary: A canvas shape at thumbnail size: its true aspect ratio fitted in a square, with the bands a platform covers with its own interface shaded (a story's top and reply bars, a reel's action rail). Decorative.

divergences: It renders the same markup and classes, inline styles included, so it fails this contract's brand-overlay (no inline style) rule exactly as the .astro does; it is not `contract` until both move their sizes off inline styles.
It takes `className`, and passes any other <span> attribute through to the root.
As for the .tsx (the same markup, inline styles included).
The box prop is `box_px`, and the insets are `[u32; 4]`.

props.name: width
props.description: The canvas width in pixels, e.g. 1080.

props.name: height
props.description: The canvas height in pixels, e.g. 1920.

props.name: safe
props.description: Platform-UI insets `[top, right, bottom, left]` in canvas pixels.

props.name: box
props.description: The square the thumbnail fits in, in CSS pixels.

props.name: class
props.description: Extra classes on the outer box.

behaviour: Fits a `width` × `height` canvas into a `box` × `box` square at its true aspect ratio (each side at least 6px), by `safeAreaBands` in `safe-area.ts`.
Each non-zero inset becomes a shaded band (`data-band` top, bottom, left or right), sized as a percentage of its axis; a zero inset renders no band.
Top and bottom bands are `--primary` at 30%; left and right at 20%.
The whole frame is aria-hidden: the caller puts the size's name and dimensions in text beside it.

default.description: A 9:16 story with top and reply bars.

rail.description: A reel with a right-hand action rail, in a larger box.

plain.description: A landscape canvas with no insets.

aria: aria-hidden="true" on the root; the caller describes the size in text.

theming.brandOverlay: The bands follow the brand's `--primary`. Nothing else changes.

noJs.without: Everything: the component is server-rendered HTML with no script.

responsive: A fixed `box` square at every width; it does not shrink (shrink-0).
contract:
contract
  slot is "safe-area-frame"
  uses safe-area-frame-canvas
  when rail slot is "safe-area-frame"
  when plain class contains "opacity-80"
end

checks.say: A story shows its top and bottom bands, and no side bands.
A reel shows only its right-hand rail.

gaps: The .tsx and .rs still size the box, canvas and bands with `style` attributes (the .astro draws them as SVG geometry since registry #430), so they share only the slot until they follow.
